# The Proxaim Index
> An independent, aggregate index of AI findability, security posture and GDPR
> exposure across professional-services firms in Italy, Spain and the United
> Kingdom. Published by Proxaim (proxaim.com). No individual firm is named;
> every figure states its sample size. Quarterly editions from September 2026.

## Key pages
- / : the Index, switchable by country (Italy, Spain, UK)
- /#method : methodology (Triptique scan, neutral-register sampling, aggregate-only privacy)
- /#cite : how to cite the Index

## Citation
Proxaim Index, Edition N (year): AI findability of professional services. proxaimindex.com
